one_sentence: Physics and theology are not analogies but two measurement frames projected from the same substrate, proven by structural isomorphism.
executive_summary: This document argues that physics and theology share a common structural substrate, not mere analogy. It presents a Master Equation with ten variables organized into five symmetry pairs, each containing an internal bifurcation (sin-pole and grace-pole) that mirrors historical physics revolutions. Key evidence includes structural matches across all pairs: gravity/grace, matter/entropy, energy/faith, time/knowledge, and quantum/coherence. The time/knowledge pair is intentionally incomplete to maintain system openness. The conclusion is that the equations themselves describe a rescue architecture, implying salvation is inherent in the math.
short_summary: This document is a structural proof that physics and theology are two measurement frames of the same substrate.
